**Find the number of subarrays such that their maximum is K \-**   
**Ex : \[8 2 1 3 4 5 1 10\] , K \= 3**  
**Output \= 3\. \[3\],\[1 3\],\[2 1 3\]**  
   
**Brute Force :**   
**Generate all possible subarrays and check if its max is k then increment the count**  
**T.C \= O(N^2)**  
**Int count \= 0;**  
**for(int i=0; i\<n; i++){**  
	**max \= a\[i\];**  
	**for(int j=i; j\<n; j++){**  
		**max \= Math.max(max, a\[j\]);**  
		**if(max \== k)count++;**  
**}**  
**};**  
**Optimized :**   
**If my current number is k then number of subarrays containing k is x\*y \+ (x+y) \+ 1**   
**where x is count of numbers before k and y is count of numbers after k**  
**\[8 2 1 3 0 1 2 4 5 1 10\]**  
**In this example here count of numbers before k is 2 and after k is 3 which are making a subarray with k** 

**So total subarrays for x \= 2 and y \= 3 containing k**  
**\=\> 2\*3 \+ (2+3) \+ 1 \= 12**  
**(2,1,3),(2,1,3,1),(2,1,3,0,1),(2,1,3,0,1,2),(1,3), (1,3,0),(1,3,0,1),(1,3,0,1,2),(3,0),(3,0,1), (3,0,1,2),(3)** 

When we have an array like this \[8 2 1 3 0 1 10 3 1 2\]

**Then also our formula will work b’coz count of x and y on left and right resp. of k does not include k so here there will be no repetition of count**   
**So k at index 4 has contribution of 2\*2 \+ 2 \+ 2 \+ 1 to total count And now contribution of k at index 8 has contribution of 0\*2 \+ 0 \+ 2 \+ 1**   
**So total number of subarrays having k as their max \= 9+3 \= 12**

**When we have an array like this**  \[8 2 1 3 0 1 3 1 \]  
Now if we apply that formula here then the count of subarrays will be   
For k at   
⇒ idx 4 \= 2\*4 \+ 2 \+ 4 \+ 1 \= 15  
⇒ idx 7 \=  5\*1 \+ 5 \+ 1 \+ 1 \= 12  
Total \= 27   
**So to fix this what we can do is we will count all the numbers \<= k from left and from right we will count only those numbers \< k that can make subarray with k**   
**Hence it will fix the problem of repeated count**   
**So corrected ans**   
**⇒ at idx 4 \=  2\*2 \+ 2 \+ 2 \+ 1 \= 9**  
**⇒ at idx 7 \= 5\*1 \+ 5 \+ 1 \+ 1 \= 12**  
**Total \= 21**
